blocks.html: A range-and-bearing line you can drop, pin in place, and shove around the map as the picture changes — unlike the fixed two-point measure line.

slides.title: Drop the line
slides.html: From the Range Tools toolbar, select the Dynamic R&B Line icon. Tap once to place an endpoint, tap again for the second point. The line stays unlocked so you can keep moving it.

slides.title: Pin it in place
slides.html: Tap the centre of the line and use the Pin button on the radial to fix the position. The pinned line shows azimuth and distance and stays put even after the Dynamic R&B Line is toggled off.

slides.title: Reposition or open the endpoint radial
slides.html: To move a pinned line, long press either end and tap a new location. To tune one end precisely, select that end to open the radial, then tap Fine Adjust.

slides.title: Fine adjust the end
slides.html: Crosshairs appear over a magnified area. Drag a finger inside it to position the end exactly, then select Confirm to accept or Cancel to discard.
